chunks: You may worship what you will apart from Him. Say: Surely the greatest losers will be those who will lose their own selves and their people on the Day of Resurrection. Remember, this will be an all-too-evident loss.
ai.seo_question: Who are considered the greatest losers on the Day of Resurrection according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Surah Az-Zumar, this verse serves as a divine concession to polytheists, inviting them to worship their chosen idols, while simultaneously declaring that the true losers are those who squander their own souls and families on the Day of Judgment. Shia scholarship emphasizes the dual nature of this loss, where 'self' refers to the spiritual essence and 'family' to one's lineage or dependents, highlighting the comprehensive ruin of both individual and communal faith. This explicit declaration of 'manifest loss' underscores the futility of shirk compared to the eternal success of the Ahl al-Bayt and the faithful.
